name: Landsat 9 (NASA / USGS)
summary: NASA and USGS flagship Earth observing mission in Sun-Synchronous Orbit (SSO) continuing a half-century baseline of multispectral terrestrial imagery, agricultural monitoring, and global climate tracking.

name: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO - NASA)
summary: NASA robotic orbiter in Low Lunar Orbit (LLO - Moon) mapping high-resolution surface topography, permanently shadowed polar water ice deposits, radiation hazards, and potential Artemis landing sites.

name: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO - NASA)
summary: NASA heavy science orbiter at Mars equipped with the HiRISE camera and SHARAD radar, conducting atmospheric profiling, searching for evidence of subsurface water ice, and providing vital deep-space relay comms.

name: MAVEN (Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN - NASA)
summary: NASA Mars orbiter investigating the dramatic loss of historical atmosphere and volatile water to space over cosmic time due to solar wind stripping and coronal mass ejection interactions.

name: Terra EOS AM-1 (NASA)
summary: Flagship multi-instrument Earth observing satellite in polar Sun-Synchronous Orbit monitoring terrestrial vegetation dynamics, aerosol optical depth, carbon cycle fluxes, and planetary energy balance.
